title: OFDM Channel Response
text: Calculate OFDM channel response, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Active subcarrier indices} sets Number of active subcarriers; {FFT length}, {Cyclic prefix length}, {Enable timing offset input port} sets the option to add input port for timing offset and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Cyclic prefix length
params.values: Cyclic prefix length of one OFDM symbol 16 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Active subcarrier indices
params.values: Number of active subcarriers 1:512 (default) | positive integer | column vector

params.name: Enable timing offset input port
params.values: Option to add input port for timing offset off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
